# 01 — Project foundation

## Goal
Deliver a static, responsive issue explainer that can run in a three-hour lab without a build system or database.

## Acceptance
- Semantic HTML, one stylesheet and one browser script.
- Article facts live in JSON and display their source qualification.
- Direct opening is graceful; serving from a local web server loads all JSON data.
- Mobile navigation/content remains readable and interactive controls have accessible names/states.

## Out of scope
Authentication, analytics, CMS, database, generic traffic-law reference, deployment pipeline.
